offers_products.reason: Sells software products: dealer websites, inventory and digital retailing tools, and the Cars.com listings platform.

offers_services.reason: Provides online marketplace listings, digital advertising and lead generation to car dealers and automakers.

sells_to_consumers.reason: Car shoppers use the site free; dealers and automakers are the paying buyers who choose the products.

sells_to_organizations.reason: Main customers are car dealerships and automotive manufacturers buying listings, advertising and software.

recurring_revenue.reason: Dealers pay monthly subscriptions for listings and software, usually under ongoing contracts.

cyclical_demand.reason: Dealers and automakers can cut advertising and marketing spend when car sales weaken.

big_ticket.reason: Dealers pay modest recurring monthly subscription fees, not large one-off purchases.

people_delivered.reason: Customers pay for the online marketplace platform, traffic and software, not mainly staff time.

large_customers.reason: Main customers are thousands of franchise and independent dealerships, many small, plus some automakers.

asset_heavy.reason: Online platform business needing software and people, not plants, fleets or properties.

notes: Consumers use the site free, so consumer buyer answer is a judgment call.
